Replicated GH20 measurements of PSGL-1 N-glycan features

glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C.Rd

N-glycan measurements accompanying the replicated GH20 enzyme comparison on pretreated PSGL-1. The two features describe exposed N-acetylglucosamine-containing N-glycans measured alongside the O-glycan core panel. Supplementary Table S10C supplies the same 15 observation columns for these two features.

Usage

glyhub_GPST000643_N_S10C

Format

A glyexp::GlycomicSE with 2 features and 15 observations. The abundance assay is in percentage of source total glycan AUC.

Source

GlycoPOST GPST000643. Supplementary Table S10C, N-glycan rows 11-12 (media-11.xlsx); classification supported by S10B N-glycan rows 25-26. Study: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.26.714468. Repository: https://glycopost.glycosmos.org/entry/GPST000643.

Details

The conditions are control, BT3178, BT3598, BT3868 and BT4681, each with Sample 1, Sample 2 and Sample 3. PSGL-1 expressing core 4 was pretreated with an enzyme mix. The expression-system species and biological versus technical replicate type are not established by these table columns. Percentages retain the source total-AUC denominator without renormalization after separation by glycan class.

Mass-labelled features 1317-1 and 1520 are source rows 11 and 12. Their compositions and complete putative-structure text are identical to S10B rows 25 and 26, located under its explicit N-glycans heading. This source correspondence supports the N classification independently of mass alone. The companion glyhub_GPST000643_O_S10C object contains the other three rows; the matrices share their observation identities and must not be counted as separate samples.

Both source compositions and putative N-glycan structures are encoded, retaining the reduced reducing ends.

See also

glyhub_data_conventions for missing-value handling, annotations and access to original measurements and source coordinates.
